What\'s stored, where, and who can see it
Everything you log stays on this phone. There\'s no account and no server, so nothing is sent anywhere.
Your data is stored in an encrypted database. The key is held by your phone\'s secure hardware and never leaves it.
Cadence doesn\'t have permission to use the internet at all, so it can\'t share your data even by mistake. There are no ads or analytics.
Cadence is excluded from Android\'s cloud backup and phone-to-phone transfer. To move to a new phone, export a backup file and restore it there.
App lock asks for your fingerprint, face or screen lock. Screenshots and the recent apps preview are blocked unless you turn that off.
Reminders are discreet by default: they only say \"Time to check in\", and the lock screen never shows more.
Backups, spreadsheets and reports are files you choose where to save. A backup without a password can be read by anyone who has the file.
Delete all data erases everything Cadence has stored on this phone.
Erase every period and setting on this phone
This permanently erases every period and setting stored by Cadence on this phone. It can\'t be undone.
Cadence is not a medical device and must not be used as contraception. Predictions are estimates. Talk to a clinician about any health concerns.
